negative_snippets: This hotel is a scam. It doesn't exist. I had booked it online and paid for a room only to go there and find that I had been cheated! I wrote to the Customer Care of Agoda and fortunately I was refunded my money after I threatened to file a case against them in the Consumer Forum. Don't book this hotel. The picture shown online is an empty building.
